content: I afasoro orou unu koreka orou seweni (7) we mune odirieka wake

Dubuenaro i iwoka ukeka orou keuwere uyareibisake i Guriki wake weibisa Du orouini ba Du farafa orouini wake we makaneibisa. Eno ukeebe i Guriki wake weibisa Du orouma eno weisa, iyanu wabu awekabobake urunaini oini daiwere make dakakunekaya eno weisa ibake wake we makaneibisa.

Eno uisaro ibake i duwero (12) afasoro orouma i Godinu wake naukeka orou yaisina weisaro faka. Fakaro i afasoro orouma eno weisa, Godinu wake da wefeisike urunaini oini i mane naka ufeisiie irauaiai meba i Godinu Imumu Irau bobo awara bunawere orou seweni (7) we muyakawero i naka naka ukeka waiya mafiaki eno weisa.
Eno weisake weisa, nono iyae iyanu mane guriguri ukeifeisike Godinu wake mane weifeisia eno weisa.

Eno weisaro emenu wake nauisake Godinu wake naukeka Imumu Irau bobo mi Sidiwinini moi orou Firifuini Fokorasini Naikeini Daimonini Famunesini nono Nikarosini danu orofa Anidiyoka, i Mi dawa Du mi ari sini, i orounu wake weisaro nauisake waure ane afasoro oroubairo odirieka.
Ane odiriekaro i afasoro orouma guriguri ukaada emenu wana emenu iiri duboro oisa.

Eno uisake Godinu wake we eneiareibisaro moi orou keuwere i wake naukeibisake Godinu wake naukeka orou sineibisa. Emua mane mero nono i Du orounu sosiro ofereni ode sibore sianeka orou keuwere Godinu wake naukeka orou sineibisa.
Godima Sidiwini we ma irauaiai uike buna daiwere mai ibake Sidiwinima buna ukekaini kawama ukekaini keuwere ukeibiro eme keuwere ibai ereibisa.

Moi du orounu sosiro guriguri ukeibisa orouma iyae iyanu onarou yawokeka oroua eno weisa. I orouini moi Sairina orouini moi Arekisania orouini moi Sirisia orouini moi Eisia orouini i oroorofa orou yaisina uyakake Sidiwinini wake we maka.
Eno uisaro danu iwoka daiwereke nono dawae Godinu Imumunu bunaroma wei ibake meisa.
Meisake anisake moi meomao weeka orou we muriekaro i meomao weeka orouma eno weisa, Sidiwinima Mosesini Godini emuabake wake merama weakua eno weisa.

Eno weisa ibake i ku siane ibisa orouma nauisake Sidiwinibake ararua daiwere uyaka. Eno uisake i dai Du orouma Sidiwini yabaisake wanayai mune ane derena enaro naama uwakake i kanisoro oroubairo waure ane oisa.
Waure ane oisaro i meomao weeka orouma eno weisa, yeka mima eno weia eno meo weisa, dawama i dai sosini Mosesinu darawadubake merama wake weakua eno weisa.
Eno weisake nono weisa, yeka mima eno weia weisa, Yesu Keriso Nasaredi Mima i dai sosi ma merama ufike Mosesinu darawadu mune siafekua eno weiro nauisia weisa.
Eno weisaro i kanisoro orou yaisina Sidiwininu iboo naisa ekabaie edoro daiwere uiro eka. I ekaie anerunu iboo naisa ari eno uiro eka.
